title: A principled approach for energy-efficient training via phase-aware GPU frequency tuning
abstract: arXiv:2609.24205v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern AI model training imposes unprecedented computational demands, making it a key contributor to datacenter energy consumption. Yet a significant fraction of the energy consumed during training does not translate to useful computation due to bottlenecks throughout the training pipeline. We present PAFT, a phase-aware, dynamically adaptable GPU frequency tuning system that reduces energy consumption of training workloads with minimal performance overhead. The key insight behind PAFT is that bottlenecks represent an energy optimization opportunity, rather than purely a performance problem: when GPUs are bound to stall, PAFT opportunistically reduces their clock frequencies to match the pace of bottlenecked devices, saving energy without impacting execution time. translated_title: 一种通过相位感知GPU频率调节实现节能训练的原则性方法
translated_abstract: 现代AI模型训练带来了前所未有的计算需求，使其成为数据中心能耗的主要贡献者之一。然而，由于训练流水线中存在各种瓶颈，训练过程中消耗的相当大一部分能量并未转化为有效计算。我们提出了PAFT，一个相位感知、动态可适应的GPU频率调节系统，能够以最小的性能开销降低训练工作负载的能耗。PAFT背后的关键洞察是：瓶颈代表的是节能优化的机会，而不仅仅是性能问题——当GPU注定要停滞等待时，PAFT会机会性地降低其时钟频率，以匹配受瓶颈限制设备的节奏，从而在不影响执行时间的情况下节省能量。PAFT通过持续监控流水线行为并应用细粒度的频率调整来实现这一目标，能够适应工作负载和系统的变化。实验表明……
tldr: 提出PAFT系统，通过相位感知地动态调节GPU频率——在GPU因流水线瓶颈而必然停滞时机会性降低时钟频率——在不影响训练性能的前提下有效降低能耗。
en_tdlr: PAFT is a phase-aware, dynamically adaptable GPU frequency tuning system that opportunistically lowers GPU clock frequencies during pipeline bottlenecks, reducing training energy consumption with minimal performance overhead.
